name: External Unit Of Measure 1 Code
definition: Specifies the external unit of measure by means of a code in the format of character string with a maximum length of 4 characters.|The list of valid codes is an external code list published separately.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

KILO.name: Kilogram
KILO.definition: Basic unit of mass in the SI system, 1000 grams.

PIEC.name: Piece
PIEC.definition: Standard length of cloth, wallpaper, as an item for sale or amount of a substance.

TONS.name: Ton
TONS.definition: Measure of weight, in Britain 2240lb (long ton)and in the US 2000lb (short ton).

METR.name: Metre
METR.definition: Unit of length in the metric system, equal to 39.37 inches.

INCH.name: Inch
INCH.definition: Measure of length equal to 2.54 cm.

YARD.name: Yard
YARD.definition: Unit of length equal to 3 feet or 0.9144 metre.

GBGA.name: GB Gallon
GBGA.definition: Unit of volume that is equal to 8 pints.

GRAM.name: Gram
GRAM.definition: Unit of measure that is equal to a 1, 000th of a kilo.

CMET.name: Centimetre
CMET.definition: Unit of measure that is equal to one hundredth of a metre.

SMET.name: Square Metre
SMET.definition: Measure of a surface, one metre by one metre.

FOOT.name: Foot
FOOT.definition: Unit of length equal to 1/3 yard.

MILE.name: Mile
MILE.definition: Unit of length equal to 1, 760 yards.

SQIN.name: Square Inch
SQIN.definition: Measure of a surface, one inch by one inch.

SQFO.name: Square Foot
SQFO.definition: Measure of a surface, one foot by one foot.

SQMI.name: Square Mile
SQMI.definition: Measure of a surface, one mile by one mile.

GBOU.name: GB Ounce
GBOU.definition: Unit of weight equal to a sixteenth of a pound.

USOU.name: US Ounce
USOU.definition: Unit of weight equal to a sixteenth of a pound.

GBPI.name: GB Pint
GBPI.definition: Unit of volume that is equal to 568 cubic centimetres.

USPI.name: US Pint
USPI.definition: Unit of volume that is equal to 473 cubic centimetres.

GBQA.name: GB Quart
GBQA.definition: Unit of volume that is equal to 2 pints.

USQA.name: US Quart
USQA.definition: Unit of volume that is equal to 2 pints.

USGA.name: US Gallon
USGA.definition: Unit of volume that is equal to 8 pints.

MMET.name: Millimetre
MMET.definition: Unit of measure that is a thousandth of one metre.

KMET.name: Kilometre
KMET.definition: Unit of measure that is equal to 1, 000 meters.

SQYA.name: Square Yard
SQYA.definition: Measure of a surface, one yard by one yard.

ACRE.name: Acre
ACRE.definition: Unit of measure equal to 4, 840 square yards.

ARES.name: Are
ARES.definition: Unit of measure equal to a 100 square meters.

SMIL.name: Square Millimetre
SMIL.definition: Measure of a surface, one millimetre by one millimetre.

SCMT.name: Square Centimetre
SCMT.definition: Measure of a surface, one centimetre by one centimetre.

HECT.name: Hectare
HECT.definition: Unit of measure that is equal to 10, 000 square meters.

SQKI.name: Square Kilometre
SQKI.definition: Measure of a surface, one kilometre by one kilometre.

MILI.name: Milli Litre
MILI.definition: Unit of volume that is equal to one thousandth of a litre.

CELI.name: Centilitre
CELI.definition: Unit of volume that is equal to one hundredth of a litre.

LITR.name: Litre
LITR.definition: Unit of volume that is equal to a thousand cubic centimetres.

PUND.name: Pound
PUND.definition: Unit of weight equal to 0.454 kilograms.

ALOW.name: Allowances
ALOW.definition: Amount of money deducted from a price or an amount due.

ACCY.name: Amount Of Currency
ACCY.definition: Number of monetary units specified in a currency, where the unit of currency is explicit and compliant with ISO 4217.

BARL.name: Barrels
BARL.definition: Unit of volume that is equal to 42 US gallons.

BCUF.name: Billion Cubic Feet
BCUF.definition: Unit of measure for large volumes of natural gas equivalent to 28316846 cubic meters.

BDFT.name: Board Feet
BDFT.definition: Measure of length equal to 144 cubic inches.

BUSL.name: Bushels
BUSL.definition: Unit of weight that is equal to 8 gallons. Mostly used for agricultural products with a specification of weight defined for each commodity differently.

CEER.name: Certified Emissions Reduction
CEER.definition: Unit of emissions type (or carbon credits) issued by the Clean Development Mechanism (CDM) Executive Board for emission reductions achieved by CDM projects and verified by a DOE (Designated Operational Entity) under the rules of the Kyoto Protocol.

CLRT.name: Climate Reserve Tonnes
CLRT.definition: Unit of offset credits used by the Climate Action Reserve. One Climate Reserve Tonne is equal to one metric ton of Greenhouse Gas (GHG) reduced/sequestered.

CBME.name: Cubic Meters
CBME.definition: Unit of volume that is equal to one meter in length, breadth and height or also equal to 1000 liters.

DAYS.name: Days
DAYS.definition: Unit of time that is equal to 24 hours.

DMET.name: Dry Metric Tons
DMET.definition: Unit of weight that is equal to the same mass value as a metric ton excluding moisture.

ENVC.name: Environmental Credit
ENVC.definition: Unit of measure for ownership of credit (or allowance) of carbon dioxide emission (in metric ton).

ENVO.name: Environmental Offset
ENVO.definition: Unit of measure for reduction of carbon dioxide emission (in metric ton) that may result in Environmental Credit.

HUWG.name: Hundredweight
HUWG.definition: Unit of weight or mass of various values in the Imperial Unit System also known as quintal, cental or centum.

KWDC.name: Kilowatt Day Capacity
KWDC.definition: Unit of measure of the capacity of production of electric power equal to 1000 watt in one day.

KWHO.name: Kilowatt Hours
KWHO.definition: Unit of measure that is equal to the power consumption of one kilowatt during one hour.

KWHC.name: Kilowatt Hours Capacity
KWHC.definition: Unit of measure of the capacity of production of electric power equal to 1000 watt in one hour.

KMOC.name: Kilowatt Minute Capacity
KMOC.definition: Unit of measure of the capacity of production of electric power equal to 1000 watt in one minute.

KWMC.name: Kilowatt Month Capacity
KWMC.definition: Unit of measure of the capacity of production of electric power equal to 1000 watt in one month.

KWYC.name: Kilowatt Year Capacity
KWYC.definition: Unit of measure of the capacity of production of electric power equal to 1000 watt in one year.

MWDC.name: Megawatt Day Capacity
MWDC.definition: Unit of measure of the capacity of production of electric power equal to 1000000 watt in one day.

MWHO.name: Megawatt Hours
MWHO.definition: Unit of measure that is equal to the power consumption of one megawatt during one hour.

MWHC.name: Megawatt Hours Capacity
MWHC.definition: Unit of measure of the capacity of production of electric power equal to 1000000 watt in one hour.

MWMC.name: Megawatt Minute Capacity
MWMC.definition: Unit of measure of the capacity of production of electric power equal to 1000000 watt in one minute.

MMOC.name: Megawatt Month Capacity
MMOC.definition: Unit of measure of the capacity of production of electric power equal to 1000000 watt in one month.

MWYC.name: Megawatt Year Capacity
MWYC.definition: Unit of measure of the capacity of production of electric power equal to 1000000 watt in one year.

TONE.name: Metric Tons
TONE.definition: Unit of mass equal to 1000 kilograms; equivalent to approximately 2,204.6 pounds, 1.102 short tons (US) or 0.984 long tons (imperial).

MIBA.name: Million Barrels
MIBA.definition: Unit of volume that is equal to 1 million barrels equivalent to 42.000.000 US gallons.

MBTU.name: One Million BTU
MBTU.definition: Unit of measure of heat equal to one million British thermal unit (BTU).

OZTR.name: Troy Ounces
OZTR.definition: Unit of weight equal to 31.1034768 grams. Used in precious metals.

UCWT.name: US Hundredweight
UCWT.definition: Unit of weight or mass of various values in the US Customary System also known as quintal, cental or centum. Equal to 100 lbs.

IPNT.name: Index Point
IPNT.definition: Decimal number used to calculate an amount or a price.

PWRD.name: Principal With Relation To Debt Instrument
PWRD.definition: Amount of money borrowed, or part of that amount which remains unpaid (excluding interest).

DGEU.name: Diesel Gallon Equivalent
DGEU.definition: Amount of fuel alternative equal to one gallon of diesel.

GGEU.name: Gasoline Gallon Equivalent
GGEU.definition: Amount of fuel alternative equal to one gallon of gasoline.

SHAS.name: Shares
SHAS.definition: Financial instrument that gives the owner right to dividends paid by a company and the most junior claim on the companies assets in the event of a bankruptcy.

THMS.name: Therms
THMS.definition: Unit of heat, often used a unit of measure for natural gas in the UK.

FUTU.name: Future
FUTU.definition: Exchange traded contract that defines an agreement to buy specific quantities of a commodity or financial instrument at an agreed time in the future.

GWHO.name: Gigawatt Hours
GWHO.definition: Unit of measure that is equal to the power consumption of one Gigawatt during one hour.

BRTU.name: British Thermal Unit
BRTU.definition: Unit of measure of heat required to raise the temperature of one pound of water by one degree Fahrenheit.

LOTS.name: Lot
LOTS.definition: Indication of the unit of measurement.

CBIN.name: Cubic Inch
CBIN.definition: Measure of a volume, one inch by one inch by one inch.

CBML.name: Cubic Millimetre
CBML.definition: Unit of volume that is equal to one thousandth of a litre.

GBFO.name: GB Fuild Ounce
GBFO.definition: Unit of volume equal to 2, 841 306 centilitre.

GBTN.name: GB Ton
GBTN.definition: Measure of weight, in Britain 2240 lb (long ton).

USBA.name: US Barrel
USBA.definition: Unit of volume equal to 158, 9873 litre.

USFO.name: US Fluid Ounce
USFO.definition: Unit of volume equal to 2, 957353 centilitre.

USTN.name: US Ton
USTN.definition: Measure of weight, in the US 2000 lb (short ton).

GGJL.name: Gigajoules
GGJL.definition: Unit of energy equal to 1,000,000,000 joules (J).

JOUL.name: Joule
JOUL.definition: Unit of energy defined as amount of work done when a force of one newton displaces a mass through a distance of one meter in the direction of that force.
